notes.title: Today’s update brings Russian localization, support for 5-button mice and some minor bug fixes.
notes.notes:
[b]CastleStorm Update![/b]
 
We have been listening to your suggestions and we are happy to announce that we’ve updated CastleStorm to accommodate more players. In this update, we have added [b]Russian localization[/b], support for mice with up to five buttons, and a few minor bug fixes. Please keep telling us what you’d like to see, as this definitely won't be the last update; we'll have more features and content coming soon!
